description: Two files set net.core.bpf_jit_harden to different values, one in /run/sysctl.d and one in /etc/sysctl.d. procps `sysctl --system` and systemd-sysctl walk the directories in different orders, so which value is in force after a reboot depends on which tool applied them — and this check will not guess. UNKNOWN naming both files, rather than a confident claim about the next boot, which is the one thing the check exists to describe.
